draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Vythiri! It's one of only three taluks in Wayanad, a mountainous, mostly forested district up on the Western Ghats. Just down the road is Pookode Lake, the smallest and highest freshwater lake in Kerala.
draft.hungryLine: Look out for bamboo rice, called Mulayari here, and wash it down with local Wayanad tea or coffee.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Vythiri town is about a 12 min walk, and Pookode Lake is a short drive away. Save a day for Edakkal Caves over in the Sultan Bathery area.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head to Pookode Lake, 770 metres up and ringed by evergreen forest and mountain slopes, and just sit by the water.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Bamboo rice is actually bamboo seed, richer in protein than rice or wheat, but it tastes like rice.

spots.name: Pookode Lake
spots.detail: Short drive · Kerala's smallest and highest freshwater lake

spots.name: Edakkal Caves
spots.detail: In the Sultan Bathery area · Look for bamboo rice payasam on the walkway

legends.title: A once-in-a-lifetime harvest
legends.body: Bamboo is said to seed only after a very long span. That's why people here say harvesting bamboo rice is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

legends.title: Kerala's little lake in the sky
legends.body: Locals are proud that Pookode is both the smallest and the highest freshwater lake in Kerala. It sits 770 metres up, wrapped in evergreen forest.

tips.title: Give it 3-4 days.
tips.body: That's enough to cover all or most of Wayanad's sights across the Kalpetta, Sultan Bathery and Mananthavady areas.

tips.title: Stick to beer or wine.
tips.body: Beer and wine are easy to find in Wayanad, but stronger drinks are prohibited.

story.title: Forest hills
story.body: Wayanad sits on the Western Ghats at around 700 metres, rising to 2,100 at its highest. Most of the land is still forest.

story.title: Temples and heritage
story.body: The district gathered temples and heritage spots, from the Jain Temple and Edakkal Caves near Sultan Bathery to the Pazhassi Raja Museum and Thirunelli Temple near Mananthavady.

story.title: Tea in the hills
story.body: Tea estates spread over the slopes, and Wayanad tea and coffee are now sold all over the district.

story.title: Weekend escape
story.body: Wayanad is a favourite weekend trip from Bangalore and Mysore, and Vythiri is one of its three taluks. Tell me what you thought of the bamboo rice.
